edges: M - 82 runs from Fremont to Howard City.
M - 82 runs along the southern edge of Manistee National Forest.
M - 82 merges with M - 37 over the Muskegon River.
The first usage of M - 82 was replaced by M - 48 in 1926.
M - 82 had a concurrency with M - 120 until it was eliminated in 1978.
M - 82 travels through the community of Fremont.
MDOT tracks the volume of traffic on M - 82.
M - 46 was extended along the section between Newaygo and Howard City, forming a concurrency with M - 82.
M - 82 was realigned to end in Shelby.
M - 82 was realigned to run from Hesperia to New Era.
The eastern end of M - 82 was moved back to Howard City.
M - 82 begins at a junction with M - 120 and B - 96 west of Fremont.
